status: Draft for review. q01–q20 from the first round; q21–q30 added for the flow kit. Astra settles every expected answer (sets expected.settledBy) before the test runs.

questions.question: In a list of payments, each row needs to show whether that payment is Paid, Pending or Failed. Which Coin component shows the status, and where does it go?

validAnswers: Badge, placed next to the item it describes in each row
required: Uses the public Badge export from jfs-components
Uses only props and modes Badge has (label, type, modes such as Semantic Intent, AppearanceSystem, Emphasis, Badge Size)
recommended: Places the Badge next to the item it describes
Short, consistent status labels (Paid, Pending, Failed), not sentences
Semantic Intent System with an AppearanceSystem meaning that agrees with each status, such as positive for Paid and negative for Failed

questions.question: A JioFinance+ plan page needs a card that lists what the plan gives (JioPoints and cashback with their amounts, plus two perks) and one button to upgrade. Which component should I use?

validAnswers: BenefitCard
required: Passes its own rows (headerItems and items, or the header and children slots) instead of relying on the placeholder default rows
recommended: Header title written as a label, such as 'You will earn'
Amounts in each row's trailingText, not in the row title
Short noun-phrase row titles
Button label is a verb, such as 'Upgrade'
The screen handles onButtonPress; no onPress on the whole card while it has a button (#280)

questions.question: An FAQ screen has six questions. Each answer should stay hidden until the person asks for it, so the page stays easy to scan. What should I use?

validAnswers: One Accordion per question, with the answer in its content slot (children)
required: Uses Accordion, with the answer in children (the content slot)
Does not set the Accordion States mode
recommended: Each header (title) names what people will find
Each answer answers its own header's question
Each Accordion keeps its own expanded state; nothing forces only one open at a time

questions.question: People need to type a longer note, two or three lines, to go with a transfer. Is Text Input the right component?

validAnswers: No: Text Input holds one line. Use NoteInput, a jfs-components export that has no entry in this pilot pack.
required: Does not configure Text Input for several lines (the guide says it holds one line; inherited React Native props such as multiline are not part of the design contract)
recommended: Uses NoteInput, and says it has no entry in the pack, so the answer rests on its types

questions.question: On the Accounts screen I want a row of tiles, one per linked bank account, plus a tile to add another account. Which Coin components should I use?

validAnswers: AccountCard tiles (state 'connected' for each account, and one with state 'add'), laid out in a row such as an HStack, or in CarouselCardAccounts when there are more than fit
required: Uses AccountCard, a real jfs-components export; does not report a missing Coin component just because the pack has no entry for it
recommended: Says AccountCard has no entry in this pilot pack, so the answer rests on its types
Titles the add tile with its action, 'Add account', and shows only a masked number on connected tiles
Uses CarouselCardAccounts when there are more tiles than fit

questions.question: Three statuses appear together: Failed, Paid and Archived. Failed needs attention. Configure the three Badges.

validAnswers: Three Badges with short labels. Failed: Semantic Intent System, AppearanceSystem negative, Emphasis High. Paid: Semantic Intent System, AppearanceSystem positive, at a lower emphasis than Failed. Archived: a quiet treatment such as AppearanceBrand Neutral with Emphasis Low.
required: Uses only real modes and values: Semantic Intent (Brand, System), AppearanceSystem (positive, warning, negative), AppearanceBrand (Primary, Secondary, Neutral, Tertiary), Emphasis (High, Medium, Low)
recommended: Failed gets the strongest emphasis; the three do not all get equal emphasis
Meaning and tone agree: Failed is not shown with a positive appearance
Labels share one style and capitalization

questions.question: Configure a Text Input where people type an amount in rupees.

validAnswers: TextInput with leadingIconName 'ic_rupee' and a short placeholder such as 'Amount'
required: Changes the leading icon with leadingIconName (or leading); does not try to remove the leading icon, which is always there
recommended: A rupee icon rather than the default search icon
A short placeholder that names what to type, with no instructions
Sets accessibilityLabel if the placeholder does not say what the field is for

questions.question: A BenefitCard is used as a read-only summary of a plan the person already has. Remove its button.

validAnswers: Set showButton to false
required: Hides the button with showButton={false}, not button={null}, which still renders the default button
Keeps passing the card's own rows rather than the placeholder defaults
recommended: Says that button={null} does not hide the button

questions.question: An Accordion titled 'Payment details' should start open and stand apart from the page as a grouped section. Configure it.

validAnswers: Accordion with defaultExpanded (or a controlled expanded with onExpandedChange) and contained
required: Opens it with defaultExpanded or expanded; does not set the Accordion States mode to force Open
recommended: contained, so the filled header keeps the group together
A header that names what people will find

questions.question: I want a Glass button on a plain white settings card. Configure it.

validAnswers: Use type 'default' instead, explaining that glass is for a meaningful backdrop such as rich media or a coloured surface
Keep type 'glass' only if a visible backdrop is added behind it, and say so
required: Uses only real Button types: default, glass, fixed
recommended: Does not put type glass on a plain, low-contrast surface
Says so when the answer departs from the request

questions.question: Build the footer of a checkout screen: one line of supporting copy, with the 'Continue' action under it, filling the width.

validAnswers: ActionFooter containing a vertical Stack with fillWidth, holding Text and then Button
required: Uses public jfs-components exports only (such as ActionFooter, Stack, Text, Button)
The action comes under the supporting copy
recommended: Stack with layoutDirection 'vertical' and fillWidth
The gap set with the Slot gap mode; no padding or wrap on Stack
Passes modes to the Coin children in the slot
A short, verb-led button label

questions.question: A payment screen has 'Payment methods' and 'Bank accounts' sections that people can expand independently; each lists account rows. The 'Confirm payment' button must always be visible. Compose the screen.

validAnswers: Two Accordions, each with ListItem rows in children, and the Confirm payment Button outside both Accordions in the page flow
required: The Confirm payment Button is not inside an Accordion's content slot
Each Accordion keeps its own expanded state (defaultExpanded, or its own expanded and onExpandedChange)
Does not set the Accordion States mode
recommended: Headers that name what people will find
The rows get the same modes as their Accordion
Confirm payment is the one strongest action (Emphasis High)

questions.question: Compose a plan screen: the title 'JioFinance+', then a BenefitCard that fills the width; pressing Upgrade starts checkout.

validAnswers: A public layout such as VStack with a Title and a BenefitCard with width '100%' whose onButtonPress starts checkout
required: The BenefitCard gets its own rows
Checkout starts from onButtonPress, the button's handler
recommended: width '100%' to fill the screen
No onPress on the whole card while it has a button (#280)
A label-style header title, amounts in trailingText, and a verb on the button

questions.question: Build a transactions search: a search field with a filter button at its end that opens a filter sheet, above the list of transactions.

validAnswers: A TextInput for the search with the filter action outside the field, for example an IconButton beside it in an HStack, above ListItem rows
A TextInput with a decorative filter icon in trailing, plus a separate pressable filter control outside the field
required: Does not put a focusable or pressable control inside the Text Input's trailing or leading slot
recommended: The screen filters the list through onChangeText
A placeholder such as 'Search transactions'
Any icon in trailing gets its own modes, such as AppearanceBrand Neutral

questions.question: Inside a slim Card, show 'September payment' on the left and its Paid status on the right.

validAnswers: Card with variant 'slim' containing an HStack (alignVertical 'center', justifyHorizontal 'space-between') with Text and a Badge
Card containing a ListItem with the Badge in its trailing slot
required: Uses public jfs-components exports only
The Badge sits beside the item it describes
recommended: The Badge uses Semantic Intent System with AppearanceSystem positive
Modes are passed to the Badge and the other Coin children

questions.question: The amount field should show 'Enter a valid amount' in red under it when the value is invalid. How do I do that with Text Input?

validAnswers: Text Input has no error state (a gap). Use FormField instead, whose isInvalid and errorMessage props show the error; FormField has no entry in this pilot pack.
Report the missing error state in Text Input as a gap
required: Does not invent error props on Text Input, or recreate an error message beside it with custom styling
Names the missing error state as a gap, or switches to a component whose types support an error
recommended: Prefers FormField (isInvalid, errorMessage) and says it has no entry in the pack

questions.question: Show a disabled Badge for a feature that isn't available yet.

validAnswers: Report that Badge has no disabled variant (a gap), rather than faking one
required: Does not invent a disabled prop or state on Badge
Does not fake a disabled look with custom colours, opacity or style overrides
recommended: Reports it as a Coin gap

questions.question: Our app has a dark theme. Make the BenefitCard dark to match.

validAnswers: Report that no mode changes the BenefitCard's white surface or black title, so it cannot be made dark (a gap)
required: Does not override the card's colours with style or hardcoded values
Reports the missing dark treatment as a gap
recommended: Says what modes can still change: AppearanceBrand recolours the icons, the upsell and the button

questions.question: Add a date picker so people can choose the date of a scheduled payment.

validAnswers: Report that Coin has no date picker component (a gap)
required: Does not invent a DatePicker or Calendar component
Does not build a date picker from Coin primitives and present it as a Coin component
Reports the missing date picker as a gap
recommended: Checks the package exports before concluding; jfs-components 0.1.78 exports no date picker

questions.question: The product page needs an embedded video player with play, pause and a progress bar.

validAnswers: Report that Coin has no video player component (a gap)
required: Does not invent a Coin video component
Reports the missing video player as a gap
recommended: Does not offer LottiePlayer, an animation player, as a video player

questions.question: On a loan application, configure the field for the applicant's PAN. It must be filled in, should show the format, and should show an error when the PAN is invalid.

validAnswers: FormField with label 'PAN', a placeholder that shows the format (such as 'ABCDE1234F'), isRequired, and isInvalid with an errorMessage that says how to fix the value
required: Uses FormField's own props: label, placeholder, isRequired, isInvalid, errorMessage
Does not use the placeholder as the label
recommended: The label names the value in sentence case ('PAN'), not an instruction such as 'Enter your PAN'
The placeholder carries the format example
The error message says how to fix the value, not only that it is wrong
The screen checks the value and sets the error; FormField only shows it

questions.question: Before submitting a loan application, the person agrees to the loan terms. Show the consent row, a way to read the full terms, and the Submit action.

validAnswers: A CheckboxItem for the consent with a specific label, a Link to the terms (in the row's end slot or beside it), and Submit as a Button, for example in an ActionFooter
required: Submit is a Button, not a Link
Uses public jfs-components exports only
recommended: The checkbox label names the choice specifically, not 'I agree to this'
The link label names the destination, such as 'Loan terms', not 'Click here'
The supporting link stays distinct from the selection
Submit is the one primary action

questions.question: Show applicants where they are in a four-stage loan application (Personal details, Income, Documents, Review) and which stages are done.

validAnswers: A Stepper with four Step children, each titled with its stage and given a status (complete for done stages, the current stage marked, upcoming stages inactive)
required: Uses Stepper with Step children
Every Step gets its own title; none keeps the default 'Stepper Item'
recommended: Titles name the stage in a few words, not actions
A Step's status and its Step Status mode stay matched (no check on purple)
The last stage shows no connector
The next action is a separate Button; Stepper is not pressable
The Stepper gets a spoken name such as 'Loan application progress'

questions.question: Let people choose a loan amount between ₹50,000 and ₹5,00,000 in steps of ₹10,000.

validAnswers: Slider with minValue 50000, maxValue 500000 and step 10000, with the value written as money, under a title
required: Uses Slider's own minValue, maxValue and step props; no invented range props
recommended: The value and the end labels are written as money (₹50,000), not raw numbers
A title sits above the slider, with room for the value bubble, and its words are the slider's spoken name (accessibilityLabel)

questions.question: On a loan offer's details screen, people switch between Overview, EMI schedule and Documents for the same offer. What should I use?

validAnswers: Tabs with three TabItem children; the screen keeps the selected tab, marks it active, and shows that view below
required: TabItems sit inside Tabs
Exactly one TabItem is active, set by the screen
recommended: Labels are short nouns in sentence case that name the view
Tabs switch views; actions such as 'Apply' stay Buttons
scrollable when the labels do not fit in one row

questions.question: Build the top bar of the offer details screen. It is a child page of the Offers list, with a back button and a share action.

validAnswers: AppBar with type 'SubPage', a short title, onLeadingPress for back, and an IconButton for share in actionsSlot with an accessibility label such as 'Share offer'
required: Uses AppBar type 'SubPage' for a child page, not 'MainPage'
Uses AppBar's own slots and props (middleSlot, actionsSlot, onLeadingPress)
recommended: A short title
Only actions that support the page
The share IconButton's accessibility label says the action

questions.question: The loan application's footer has 'Back' and 'Continue'. Build it so Continue clearly advances the application.

validAnswers: ActionFooter holding a ButtonGroup with Back and then Continue, Continue with the stronger emphasis
required: One action is clearly primary; Back and Continue do not both get the strongest emphasis
recommended: ButtonGroup for a row of actions (Stack for a vertical order)
Size and modes set once on the group, not per child
The group is given a width
Short verb-led labels, ending with the action people are most likely to choose

questions.question: On the offer details tabs, the 'Documents' tab should be disabled until the application is approved. How do I do that?

validAnswers: Report that Tabs and TabItem have no disabled state (a gap), rather than faking one
required: Does not invent a disabled prop on TabItem or Tabs
Does not fake a disabled look with styles
recommended: Reports it as a Coin gap

questions.question: On the offer details screen, suggest adding a co-applicant to get a higher amount, with one action, and let people dismiss the suggestion.

validAnswers: Nudge with its own title (the benefit), body (one sentence of detail) and buttonLabel (a verb), onPressButton, and onClose, which the screen uses to remove it
required: Sets its own title, body and button label; does not ship the placeholder copy
The screen removes the Nudge on close; it has no hidden state of its own
recommended: Context mode 'Nudge&Alert' so the button is the small size
One action
Uses a type that supports a button and close (not stacked-detailed)

questions.question: Compose the confirmation screen after a personal loan application is submitted: the title 'Application submitted', a line saying the decision arrives within 24 hours, the application's progress, and a 'Go to home' action.

validAnswers: A Screen (or VStack page flow) with Title, Text, a Stepper of titled Steps showing the stages and their status, and a Button, for example in an ActionFooter
required: Uses public jfs-components exports only
The action is a separate Button; the Stepper is not pressable
Every Step has its own title
recommended: The Stepper gets a spoken name
Step titles name the stages
One primary action with a verb-led label
